description: Resolve uncertain actions across the host's base mechanics: Fate Fudge dice, aspects, Fate points, and stress; Ironsworn momentum, moves, and progress; Forged action rolls, stress, trauma, and downtime; and generic ruleset table rolls. Rolls and state changes persist to the Novel and are audited; a roll with no following write is flagged as an uncommitted roll. Revert the most recent mutation with manage_history (action: undo). fate_roll uses dF, ironsworn_move compares an action die against two challenge dice, and forged_action_roll takes the highest of a d6 pool. Use when: resolving a Fate, Ironsworn, or Forged mechanic, or rolling on a ruleset generation table. Do NOT use when: resolving a ruleset skill check — use the bound ruleset's roll tools; managing vows — use manage_vow (action: set).

action.description: roll (ruleset table), fate_* (Fate), ironsworn_* (Ironsworn), or forged_* (Forged in the Dark).

adds.description: Stat and bonuses added to the action die (ironsworn_move).

amount.description: Fate points (fate_point), stress (fate_stress, forged_stress, forged_downtime), or momentum (ironsworn_momentum); defaults to 1.

burn.description: Burn momentum to replace the action score (ironsworn_move).

cost.description: Stress cost to resist (forged_stress); defaults to 2.

dice.description: Fudge dice notation (fate_roll) or dice pool size (forged_action_roll).

entity_id.description: Entity or NPC id (fate_aspect, fate_point, fate_stress, ironsworn_momentum, ironsworn_move, forged_stress, forged_downtime).

modifier.description: Skill rating added to the roll (fate_roll).

name.description: Aspect name, progress-track name, move name, action name, or consequence label.

op.description: Sub-operation for aspect, fate_point, stress, momentum, progress, or downtime.

seed.description: Deterministic seed (fate_roll, ironsworn_move, ironsworn_progress, forged_action_roll, roll).

shifts.description: Shifts to mark on a stress track (fate_stress); defaults to 1.

skill.description: Skill name for the roll label (fate_roll).

slug.description: Ruleset slug for a Novel-independent roll (roll).

target.description: Aspect target: 'scene' or an entity/NPC id (fate_aspect); defaults to 'scene'.

track.description: Stress track to mark or clear (fate_stress).

name: resolve_mechanic

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Resolve Mechanics
